style.styleTitle: Personalised Scallop Trim Wooden Christmas Bauble by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: Add a classic festive touch to your Christmas tree with this Personalised Green Scallop Trim Wooden Bauble. Featuring a charming scallop edge design and traditional green finish, this beautifully crafted wooden decoration can be personalised with 5 lines of text (Line 1: up to 15 characters, Line 2: up to 12 characters, Line 3: up to 12 characters, Line 4: up to 15 characters, Line 5: up to 15 characters), making it a thoughtful Christmas gift or keepsake. This decoration comes supplied with a ribbon ready to hang straight onto the tree. The colour of ribbon may vary. Perfect for hanging on the tree or adding to seasonal displays, it brings a warm, rustic and personalised feel to any festive home décor. Dimensions(mm): Height: 100 Width: 107 Depth: 6.
